## Findings

1. **F1 — Document archival is falsely described as automatic on completion.** [core-model.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/core-model.md:181) and [example-config.toml](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/example-config.toml:19) say documents archive when work completes. Archival only occurs through explicit `jit doc archive`. Remediate both statements to describe explicit archival.

2. **F2 — Storage format incorrectly makes every description Markdown and omits its persisted format field.** [storage-format.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/storage-format.md:86) describes the body as Markdown, but issues may carry optional `content_format` values (`markdown`, `html`, or `xml`) and otherwise inherit the repository default. Remediate the field table with `content_format` and its inheritance behavior.

3. **F3 — Priority labels are incorrectly called non-label built-ins.** [core-model.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/core-model.md:882) says `priority:*` is “not a label.” The shipped configuration includes a `priority` label namespace, distinct from the issue priority field. Remediate to distinguish the namespace from the field.

4. **F4 — Assignee kinds are falsely documented as a closed set.** [core-model.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/core-model.md:1040) lists three “supported types,” but parsing accepts any non-empty `kind:identifier` pair. Remediate by presenting `human`, `agent`, and `bot` as examples.

5. **F5 — The precheck diagram starts from the wrong lifecycle state.** [core-model.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/core-model.md:557) runs a precheck from `backlog` to `in_progress`; handlers run prechecks only on `ready → in_progress`. Remediate the Mermaid transition.

6. **F6 — Automated gates are falsely presented as self-running.** [custom-gates.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/how-to/custom-gates.md:117) says automated gates run automatically. A checker runs when `jit gate evaluate` is explicitly invoked. Remediate the workflow to invoke evaluation.

7. **F7 — Run-history documentation incorrectly includes stderr.** [custom-gates.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/how-to/custom-gates.md:439) says prior `stdout`/`stderr`/exit code are supplied. The handler deliberately clears stderr before passing run history to a checker. Remediate to exclude stderr.

8. **F8 — Gate failure semantics are reversed.** [core-model.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/core-model.md:528) and [cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1485) say failures are automated/manual failure is inappropriate. `jit gate fail` rejects automated gates and records failure for manual gates; automated failures come from evaluation. Remediate the diagram, example, and note.

9. **F9 — Create’s `--force` flag is described incorrectly.** [cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:422) says it bypasses validation warnings. Warnings never block; `--force` bypasses blocking `enforce = true` rule failures and records the bypass. Remediate the flag description.

10. **F10 — The lead issue-update JSON contract is a full issue object, not the actual confirmation shape.** [cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:16) shows title, priority, labels, dependencies, and gates, while the handler returns only id, short_id, state, updated_at, and message. Remediate the lead example to match the later correct confirmation example.

11. **F11 — Two preset-application pipelines are invalid.** [cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1664) pipes human-readable query output into `xargs`, and [cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1810) also uses nonexistent `query all --filter`. Remediate with `query all --label … --json | jq -r '.issues[].id' | xargs jit gate preset apply …`.

12. **F12 — Preset application incorrectly requires at least one issue ID.** [cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1640) and [cli-command-grammar.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-command-grammar.md:74) document one-or-more IDs. Clap defines `[IDS]...`; zero IDs succeeds and applies to no issues. Remediate the grammar and usage as optional IDs.

13. **F13 — Preset-name validation is overstated.** [cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1731) says special characters are invalid. The command rejects an empty or built-in name, not a general special-character class. Remediate to state the actual checks.

14. **F14 — Issue creation is falsely said to require pre-registered gate keys.** [cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:419) says every `--gate` key must already exist. Creation persists supplied keys without registry lookup; `jit validate` later detects unknown references. Remediate the create behavior description and explain the later integrity check.

15. **F15 — The CI gate-status script can report success with pending gates.** [software-development.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/how-to/software-development.md:541) through [line 551](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/how-to/software-development.md:551) inspects only `.results`, which contains recorded automated runs rather than every required gate. Remediate it to require `.all_passed == true` or inspect `.gates`, including pending manual and automated gates.

16. **F16 — Multi-agent safety claims invent field-level conflict resolution and overstate ordinary claiming.** [README.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/README.md:26) and [guarantees.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/guarantees.md:309) claim locks/ordinary claims prevent races or use first-writer-wins field resolution. Writes replace whole issue records after reads; ordinary `issue claim` is not exclusive. Remediate to distinguish atomic replacement and lease acquisition from field merging, and direct exclusive workflows to `jit claim acquire`.

Total findings: 16
